close_reason: Space types re-exported from jmap-chat-types. Serde helpers added for SpaceRole, SpaceMember, Category, ChannelPermission. SPACE_PERMISSION_NAMES constant added.
description: Create types that jmap-chat-types already provides (Space, SpaceRole, SpaceMember, Category, SpaceInvite, SpaceBan, ChannelPermission). Since we adopted jmap-chat-types, most of these are already defined there — re-export them from kith-core. Add BroadcastMention-style helpers (make_space_role, etc.) for any #[non_exhaustive] types without constructors. Add space_id field to Chat (already present in jmap-chat-types Chat struct but not populated). Verify ChatKind::Channel is usable. No new code files needed if types are re-exported.
title: Spaces Phase 1a: Define Space-layer types in kith-core
